## Data preparation

```{r}
# DATA PREPARATION
# unify Q5
# omit vars that are not useful
# unify question names
# keep only complete obs

days_per_month <- 365.25 / 12

any(!is.na(proact$Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy) & !is.na(proact$Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy) &
      proact$Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy != proact$Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy)
#TODO: need to resolve this

proact_full <- proact %>% 
    mutate(Q5_Cutting_Combined = if_else(is.na(Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy), 
                                         Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy, Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy)) %>%
    select(-Q5b_Cutting_with_Gastrostomy, -Q5a_Cutting_without_Gastrostomy, 
           -Q10_Respiratory, -ALSFRS_Total, -Mode_of_Administration, -ALSFRS_Responded_By) %>%
    filter(if_all(c(starts_with("Q"), starts_with("R")), function(x) { !is.na(x) } )) 


question_col_names_proact <- sort(names(proact_full)[grepl("^[QR]", names(proact_full))])
question_col_names <- sprintf("Q%02d", 1:12)
question_col_names_translation <- sprintf("Q%02d", 1:12)
names(question_col_names_translation) <- question_col_names_proact

proact_standardized <- proact_full %>%
    rename_with(function(x) { question_col_names_translation[x]}, .cols = all_of(question_col_names_proact)) %>%
    rename(alsfrs_total = ALSFRS_R_Total) %>%
    mutate(alsfrs_dly_mnths = ALSFRS_Delta / days_per_month) %>%
    select(subject_id, all_of(question_col_names), alsfrs_total, alsfrs_dly_mnths) 


proact_standardized
```

## Simulate data

```{r}

# SIMULATION SCENARIO
nsims = 100
nsims_sub <- 100 #size for subsample for testing the models
n_subjects_per_group <- 100
eff_probs <- rep(c(0.5, 0.7, 0.8), times = nsims) # define the no. of simulations here 
eff_prob <- eff_probs[seq(from = 1, to = length(eff_probs), by = 3)][1:nsims_sub]  # only 0.5
```

```{r}

# SIMULATE DATA 
#set.seed(468652233)
set.seed(234)

sims <- list()
for(i in 1:length(eff_probs)) {
  sims[[i]] <- simulate_data_from_registry(proact_standardized,
                                    max_duration = 12,
                                    min_measurements_per_subject = 2,
                                    max_measurements_per_subject = 3,
                                    n_subjects_per_group = n_subjects_per_group,
                                    effect_prob = eff_probs[i])
  if(i <= 15) {
  print(sims[[i]] %>% ggplot(aes(x = alsfrs_dly_mnths, y = alsfrs_total - alsfrs_start, group = subject_id,
                                color = group)) +
    geom_line(position = position_jitter(height = 0.3), alpha = 0.5) + ggtitle(paste0("Eff prob: ", eff_probs[i]))) 
  }
}

```

### Logit model

```{r}

#RANDOM INTERCEPT 
formula_text <- paste0(question_to_fit, " ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths * group + (1 | subject_id)")

logit_formula <- as.formula(formula_text)

args_per_fit <- list()
for(i in 1:length(sims_null)) {
  data_for_fit <- sims_null[[i]] %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(question_col_names), function(x) { x + 1 }))
  args_per_fit[[i]] <- list(data = data_for_fit)
}


#RANDOM SLOPE
formula_text_rslope <- paste0(question_to_fit, " ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths * group + (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths | subject_id)")

logit_formula_rslope <- as.formula(formula_text_rslope)


```

```{r}

#RANDOM INTERCEPT
fits_logit <- brm_parallel(
    args_shared = list(formula = bf(logit_formula, family = cumulative()), #+ set_rescor(FALSE), not applicable, we have one question only 
                                    adapt_delta = 0.95,
                                    init = 0.1,
                                    chains = 3,
                                    iter = 3000,
                                    warmup = 1000),
    args_per_fit = args_per_fit,
    cache_dir = cache_dir,
    cache_fits = TRUE,
    future.globals = FALSE)

#RANDOM SLOPE
fits_logit_rslope <- brm_parallel(
    args_shared = list(formula = bf(logit_formula_rslope, family = cumulative()), #+ set_rescor(FALSE), not applicable, we have one question only 
                                    adapt_delta = 0.95,
                                    init = 0.1,
                                    chains = 3,
                                    iter = 3000,
                                    warmup = 1000),
    args_per_fit = args_per_fit,
    cache_dir = cache_dir,
    cache_fits = TRUE,
    future.globals = FALSE)

```

```{r}

#FUNCTION FOR THE LOGIT EFFECTS 
#(the only change in the original function is the -1 in the col_values)
effects_logit <- function(fit) {
  predict_data <- data.frame(group = c("Control", "Control", "Treatment", "Treatment"),
                             alsfrs_dly_mnths = c(0, 12, 0, 12))
  
  pred <- posterior_epred(fit, newdata = predict_data, re_formula = NA)
  
  expected_sum <- function(x) {
    col_values <- as.integer(colnames(x)) - 1 #back to the real values of the categories
    multiplied <- sweep(x, MARGIN = 2, STATS = col_values, FUN = "*")
    rowSums(multiplied)
  }
  
  start_control <- expected_sum(pred[,1,])
  end_control <- expected_sum(pred[,2,])
  start_treatment <- expected_sum(pred[,3,])
  end_treatment <- expected_sum(pred[,4,])
  
  (end_treatment - start_treatment) - (end_control - start_control)
}

```

```{r}

#COMPUTE THE EFFECTS AND ORGANIZE THEM IN A SINGLE DATAFRAME 
all_effects_logit <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_prob), #change length eff_probs here
                             ~ data.frame(id = .x, type = "logit", eff_prob = eff_prob[.x], estimate = effects_logit(fits_logit[[.x]])))

#RANDOM SLOPE

                             ~ data.frame(id = .x, type = "logit_rslope", eff_prob = eff_prob[.x], estimate = effects_logit(fits_logit_rslope[[.x]])))
```

### Lme4 checks

#### Simple

```{r}

# FIT SIMPLE LMER MODEL
fits_lmer_simple <- purrr::map(sims_null, function(data_for_lmer) {
  lme4::lmer(data_for_lmer[[question_to_fit]] ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths*group+ (1 |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

fits_lmer_simple_rslope  <- purrr::map(sims_null, function(data_for_lmer) {
  lme4::lmer(data_for_lmer[[question_to_fit]] ~ 1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths*group+ (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

```

```{r}

#FUNCTION FOR THE LMER SIMPLE EFFECTS 
effects_lmer_simple <- function(fit) {
  # Estimating conf ints. for a linear combination
  # Based on https://bookdown.org/ccolonescu/RPoE4/intervalest.html
  vc <- vcov(fit)
  
  lincomb <- rep(0, nrow(vc))
  names(lincomb) <- rownames(vc)
  lincomb["groupTreatment"] <- 1
  lincomb["alsfrs_dly_mnths:groupTreatment"] <- 12

  alpha <- c(0.5, 0.05)
  estimate <- as.numeric(lincomb %*% fit@beta)
  df <- df.residual(fit)
  tcr <- qt(1-alpha/2, df)
  estimate_se <- as.numeric(sqrt( lincomb %*% (vc %*% lincomb)))
  lower <- estimate - tcr*estimate_se
  upper <- estimate + tcr*estimate_se
  data.frame(estimate = estimate, lower95 = lower[2], lower50 = lower[1], upper50 = upper[1],
             upper95 = upper[2])
}

```

```{r}

# COMPUTE THE EFFECTS AND ORGANIZE THEM IN A SINGLE DATAFRAME 
all_effects_lmer_simple <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_prob), 
                             ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_simple", eff_prob = eff_prob[.x], effects_lmer_simple(fits_lmer_simple[[.x]]))))

all_effects_lmer_simple_rslope <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_prob), 
                             ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_simple_rslope", eff_prob = eff_prob[.x], effects_lmer_simple(fits_lmer_simple_rslope[[.x]]))))

```

#### Splines

```{r}

# FIT LMER SPLINES MODEL
get_spline_coeffs <- function(x) {
  res <- ns(x, knots = 6, Boundary.knots = c(0, 12))
  colnames(res) <- paste0("dly_mnths_spline_", 1:ncol(res))
  res
}

fits_lmer_splines <- purrr::map(sims_null, function(data_for_lmer) {
    
     spline_data <- ns(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths, 2)
         data_for_lmer <- cbind(data_for_lmer,
                           get_spline_coeffs(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths))
     
  lme4::lmer(data_for_lmer[[question_to_fit]] ~ 1 + dly_mnths_spline_1 * group
             + dly_mnths_spline_2 * group + (1 |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})

fits_lmer_splines_rslope <- purrr::map(sims_null, function(data_for_lmer) {
    
     spline_data <- ns(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths, 2)
         data_for_lmer <- cbind(data_for_lmer,
                           get_spline_coeffs(data_for_lmer$alsfrs_dly_mnths))
     
  lme4::lmer(data_for_lmer[[question_to_fit]] ~ 1 + dly_mnths_spline_1 * group
             + dly_mnths_spline_2 * group + (1 + alsfrs_dly_mnths |subject_id), data = data_for_lmer)
})



```

```{r}

#FUNCTION FOR THE LMER SPLINES EFFECTS 
effects_lmer_splines <- function(fit) {
  # Estimating conf ints. for a linear combination
  # Based on https://bookdown.org/ccolonescu/RPoE4/intervalest.html
  vc <- vcov(fit)
  
  spline_coeffs_0 <- get_spline_coeffs(0)
  spline_coeffs_12 <- get_spline_coeffs(12)
  spline_coeffs_diff <- spline_coeffs_12 - spline_coeffs_0
  
  lincomb <- rep(0, nrow(vc))
  names(lincomb) <- rownames(vc)
  lincomb["groupTreatment"] <- 1
  lincomb["dly_mnths_spline_1:groupTreatment"] <- spline_coeffs_diff[1]
  lincomb["groupTreatment:dly_mnths_spline_2"] <- spline_coeffs_diff[2]
  
  alpha <- c(0.5, 0.05)
  estimate <- as.numeric(lincomb %*% fit@beta)
  df <- df.residual(fit)
  tcr <- qt(1-alpha/2, df)
  estimate_se <- as.numeric(sqrt( lincomb %*% (vc %*% lincomb)))
  lower <- estimate - tcr*estimate_se
  upper <- estimate + tcr*estimate_se
  data.frame(estimate = estimate, lower95 = lower[2], lower50 = lower[1], upper50 = upper[1],
             upper95 = upper[2])
}


```

```{r}

#COMPUTE THE EFFECTS AND ORGANIZE THEM IN A SINGLE DATAFRAME 
all_effects_lmer_splines <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_prob), 
                             ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_splines", eff_prob = eff_prob[.x], effects_lmer_splines(fits_lmer_splines[[.x]]))))

all_effects_lmer_splines_rslope <- purrr::map_df(1:length(eff_prob), 
                             ~ cbind(data.frame(id = .x, type = "lmer4_splines_rslope", eff_prob = eff_prob[.x], effects_lmer_splines(fits_lmer_splines_rslope[[.x]]))))
```

### Joined

```{r}

#JOINED PLOT
summarise_brms <- function(all_effects) {
  all_effects %>% group_by(type, eff_prob, id) %>%
    summarise(lower95 = quantile(estimate, 0.025),
              lower50 = quantile(estimate, 0.25),
              upper50 = quantile(estimate, 0.75),
              upper95 = quantile(estimate, 0.975),
              estimate = mean(estimate),
              .groups = "drop")
}

my_pos <- position_dodge(width = 0.5)

rbind(summarise_brms(all_effects_logit),
      summarise_brms(all_effects_logit_rslope),
      all_effects_lmer_splines,
      all_effects_lmer_splines_rslope,
      all_effects_lmer_simple,
      all_effects_lmer_simple_rslope) %>%
    mutate(eff_prob = factor(eff_prob)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(id), group = interaction(id, type), color = type)) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower50, ymax = upper50), size = 1.2, position = my_pos) +
    geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lower95, ymax = upper95), position = my_pos) +
    geom_point(aes(y = estimate), position = my_pos, size = 3) +
    facet_wrap(~eff_prob, scales = "free", ncol = 2) +
    theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_blank())


```

#### Coverage

```{r}

#CHECK THE COVERAGE 
summary <- rbind(summarise_brms(all_effects_logit),
                 summarise_brms(all_effects_logit_rslope),
      all_effects_lmer_splines,
      all_effects_lmer_splines_rslope,
      all_effects_lmer_simple,
      all_effects_lmer_simple_rslope) %>%
      mutate(effect = ifelse(eff_prob == 0.5, 0, NA), 
             covered = effect <= upper95 & effect >= lower95, 
             length = upper95 - lower95) %>%
    group_by(type, eff_prob) %>%
    summarise(coverage = mean(covered), 
              meanlength = mean(length),
              .groups = "drop") %>%            
    group_by(eff_prob) %>%                      
    mutate(RE = meanlength[type == "lmer4_simple"] / meanlength) %>%
    ungroup()

summary

```
